studies.title: The okapi
studies.caption: Striped legs break up the okapi's outline in a forest of light and shadow. The animal was known to Ituri forest communities long before it became known abroad.
studies.prompt: Full-body female Okapia johnstoni in shaded Congo rainforest understory, rich chocolate-brown torso, zebra-like white horizontal stripes only on rump and upper legs, pale lower legs, large ears, white cheeks. Looking back over shoulder, all four legs physically coherent, no zebra-striped torso or long giraffe neck.
